1. Claim 4 (Currently Amended): __A method of impeding Leishmaniasis transmission in humans comprising administering to a human subject a composition comprising a Fucose Mannose Ligand (FML) fraction isolated from Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes and saponin, wherein the FML fraction is derived from Leishmania chagasi or Leishmania infantum species, and wherein said composition is formulated as a blocking vaccine capable of inducing blocking antibodies in human subjects at therapeutic concentrations below 400 μg/ml.__

2. Claim 5 (Currently Amended): __Use of the composition of claim 4 for preparation of a blocking vaccine to impede Leishmaniasis transmission in humans, wherein the composition comprises FML derived from Leishmania chagasi or Leishmania infantum and saponin.__

3. Claim 6 (Currently Amended): __Use of the composition of claim 4 for preparation of a reagent for blocking Leishmaniasis transmission in humans or animals, wherein said composition further comprises suitable pharmacological vehicles, and wherein the FML is derived from Leishmania chagasi or Leishmania infantum species.__

4. Claim 7 (Currently Amended): __The composition of claim 4, wherein the Leishmania promastigotes or Leishmania amastigotes fractions called "Fucose Mannose Ligand" (FML) are derived from Leishmania chagasi or Leishmania infantum and comprise a glycoprotein complex containing 29% of neutral sugar, 44% of protein, 11% of phosphate and hexoamines traces composed by protein bands with molecular weight ranging from 9 to 95 kDa, some protein bands having carbohydrates at 36 and 54 to 68 kDa, the FML glycidic portion presenting 10% of fucose and 47% of mannose, 30% of glucose, 12% of galactose and xylose traces, aminoacids containing 10 to 20% of glutamic acid, alanine, aspartic acid and glycine, 5 to 10% of serine, histidine, lysine, leucine, threonine, proline and valine, and 2 to 5% of arginine, methionine, isoleucine, tyrosine and phenylalanine.__
